command: pre-registration: TV-F, test-time role views on frozen VLAs (docs/SCAFFOLD_RESULTS.md 46)

metrics.arms: I = results/flawed/pp_atlas/<model>_<tid> (atlas intact, same states / branches / seeds / server); tv = role views from sc_seg learned masks in both cameras, sc_rv.role_paint rule (object phase: every movable but the object painted; target phase: every movable but the target, held object included), switched by ProprioHeld (sc_rv_lex.json tw/lift) stepped every env step, current state (reverts if the hold ends), prompt unchanged; tvp = tv + R1 role phrases (sc_t16.given); w = whole wrist image grey 128 while ProprioHeld is on, no silhouettes, prompt unchanged.
metrics.mapping: experiments/tv_frozen.py read as hashed, per model.  Success matrices [task, state]; paired bootstrap B=2000, numpy default_rng(0), tasks and states drawn jointly; CI 2.5/97.5.  PRIMARY d = tv - I on N1-N6: TV WINS iff d > .10 and CI lo > 0; TV LOSES iff CI hi < -.10; else NO CLEAR DIFFERENCE.  AC-VLA d = tv - w on N1-N6, same rule: SEPARATED FROM AC-VLA iff win; TV LOSES TO W iff hi < -.10; else NO CLEAR DIFFERENCE.  No verdict: tvp - I, tvp - tv, w - I; K-task success per arm and arm - I (cost on trained tasks); the atlas's within/cross-chunk excess (pp_atlas estimator, partners, stage rule unchanged) per arm; stage shares; segmenter IoU, paint IoU, active-object leak; hold onsets vs oracle Held.  I's excess must reproduce pp_atlas_read.json (reported).
metrics.prediction: pi0.5 (I .50 on N1-N6): NO CLEAR DIFFERENCE 50%, TV WINS 30%, TV LOSES 20%. GR00T (I .167): TV WINS 40%, NO CLEAR DIFFERENCE 45%, TV LOSES 15%. tv - w: NO CLEAR DIFFERENCE on both models (70%). K-task success under tv within .10 of I on pi0.5, a larger drop possible on GR00T. tv lowers the cross-chunk excess against I on both models. Paint IoU >= .90 agentview, segmenter weakest on the bottle in the wrist.
metrics.seen: Smoke before registration and before the predictions: pi0.5 only, smoke states 0-3 (n2_branches_smoke.json), N1 / N4 / K1 familiar, job 4677916. Successes of 4: tv N1 2, N4 3, K1 4; tvp N1 4, N4 2, K1 4; w N1 4, N4 0, K1 4. ProprioHeld first onset within 0-2 steps of the oracle Held on most episodes; paint IoU .94-.98 agentview, .96-.995 wrist; active leak <= .007. Contact sheets inspected: the rule paints as intended. No gate, threshold, rule or code changed after the smoke. GR00T was not smoked. The intact arm I is not run here; it reuses results/flawed/pp_atlas (seen in earlier registered reads: pi0.5 .50, GR00T .167 on N1-N6).
metrics.tasks: familiar n2 tids 16,18,20,22,24,26 (N1-N6) and 0,2,4,6,10 (K1-K4, K6); states 4-23; models pi05, groot (pp_serve_purify --mode intact --seed 13).
